name: list_reminders
summary: List reminders from Reminders.app. Returns each reminder's id — pass that id to modify_reminder, complete_reminder, or delete_reminder. By default only incomplete reminders are shown.

params.name: list
params.description: Restrict to a single reminders list by exact name. Omit to list across all lists.

params.name: include_completed
params.description: Include reminders that are already marked complete (default false).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of reminders to return (default 25, maximum 100).

name: add_reminder
summary: Create a reminder. A due day is optional; include a due_time for a timed alert, or give only due_date for an all-day reminder. STAGED for confirmation; undo deletes the created reminder.

params.name: list
params.description: Exact name of the reminders list to add to (e.g. "Reminders").

params.name: due_date
params.description: Optional due day, in YYYY-MM-DD form.

params.name: due_time
params.description: Optional time of day for the due date, in 24-hour HH:MM form. Requires due_date. With a time the reminder alerts at that moment; without one it is an all-day reminder.

params.name: notes
params.description: Optional notes / body text for the reminder.

name: modify_reminder
summary: Change an existing reminder identified by its id (from list_reminders). Supply the new title; due date and notes are changed only if provided. STAGED for confirmation; undo restores the prior values.

params.name: list
params.description: Exact name of the list the reminder lives in (from list_reminders).

params.name: id
params.description: The reminder's id, as returned by list_reminders.

params.name: title
params.description: New reminder title / name (supply the current one unchanged if you only mean to change the due date).

params.name: due_date
params.description: If provided, sets a new due day in YYYY-MM-DD form. If omitted, the existing due date is left unchanged.

params.name: due_time
params.description: Optional time of day for the new due date, in 24-hour HH:MM form. Requires due_date.

params.name: notes
params.description: If provided, replaces the reminder's notes/body. If omitted, the existing notes are left unchanged.

name: complete_reminder
summary: Mark a reminder complete, identified by its id (from list_reminders). STAGED for confirmation; undo marks it incomplete again.

params.name: list
params.description: Exact name of the list the reminder lives in (from list_reminders).

params.name: id
params.description: The reminder's id, as returned by list_reminders.

name: delete_reminder
summary: Delete a reminder identified by its id (from list_reminders). STAGED for confirmation; undo re-creates the reminder from the details captured before deletion.

params.name: list
params.description: Exact name of the list the reminder lives in (from list_reminders).

params.name: id
params.description: The reminder's id, as returned by list_reminders.
